definition.event: Campbell factorial measure on chronological electrical launches: R² dt dlag B(x1) B(x2) dx1 dx2 C(t1) C(t2); 2 times chronological count gives ordered count. Count a pair once on first 3-sigma support intersection after causal formation; later reflected episodes add residence, not events. The launch-lag and offset disk are an explicit jitter denominator, not the historical Pass4 source cutoff. 1-sigma core and appreciable core additionally distinguish a normalized native optical or direct-response level e^-3 on both parents, not a measured physical cut.
definition.sampling: Rate/geometry uses independent proposals at the live-anchor pair-Palm mean linear strain, retaining resolved whole-foil temperature/electronic refraction and identical Campbell/Jacobian factors. The mean closure for geometry does not set strain to zero or estimate instantaneous displacement. Independent live anchor draws evolve signed response through the strongest sampled overlap; their weights are not added to the geometry counts. Independent incident-probe draws sample both parents at their live source times and carry their own sample normalization. Geometry Monte Carlo errors are conditional on the estimated mean strain.
definition.probe: Independent incident track probe with own .85/.30 D weighting, exact D(z) column and flight lag. Unordered pair occupation = 1/2 factorial moment of two simultaneously supporting distinct parents at that probe. Proposal factor is C(t_probe_launch)/(2s q(t)), times two launch factors R B(x)C(t_parent)/[q(x)q(age)]; q(x) is a nested-disk area mixture, q(age) is a uniform/physical-decay mixture. Sample mean normalization is in weights. Use probe_column_weight_m2 for G12 and use single_occupation_weight for matched one-parent replacement. No incident probe coincides with a parent electrical mark.
definition.connected: Use F(joined)-F(parent1)-F(parent2)+F(quiet) at identical probe lab energy and T. F(joined)-F(additive) isolates projected nonlinear dynamics; do not count ordinary one-parent population twice. theta is isotropic moving-target thermal population, v is signed axial canonical velocity, not covariance.
definition.transport: Accepted tracking/debits, actual D profile, native m16 phase-space populations by Bloch row, reflected front/back shell centre with unit free optical image energy, true source flight offsets and same-parent D2 echo. Retained angularly isotropized Hessian spreading and first-order refractive ray gradients about the common whole-foil chart; launches within the jitter disk use the same lateral Taylor chart. The archived integrated native phase resolves the fs quench while the warm innovation uses the same transported foil. Phase and arrival clocks are integrated separately to avoid subtracting nearby whole seconds for femtosecond phase.
definition.interaction: Same native K4_100 axial RWA self and cross terms, plus G3 Hartree contraction with the other parent’s actual incoherent q variance. Phase is the common H action derivative, canonical momentum is measured by Ω Im(q), and no pair amplitude gain is inserted. All cross terms use the same D-weighted Gaussian overlap with continuous compact support; close-k exchange and FWM remain unretained.
definition.controls: Additive is the same two responses with cross quartic disabled. Frozen replaces the linear phase by a cold matched phase at equal source phasor, observed geometry, population and attenuation. Shuffled adds independent constant phases to complete parent phasors, not to D2 or reflected paths. Pure dephasing coherently attenuates and is not lost from the covariance.
definition.work: First-order parent-clock curvature work (eV) enters from that parent’s hot e, thermal e or incoherent optical reservoirs with opposite donor amounts; spatial background refraction is separate. Damping routes .2 to thermal e, .8 to Pd. The pair quartic separately charges parent insertion and echoes, physical damping to the same carriers, and coefficient-change work to the optical ray/shape port. Opposite signed native q-population work is propagated back through the optical population Green to the probe covariance, including the inherited hot-e to optical path. Prescribed rays are the leading eikonal approximation: opposite ray-work demand prices omitted backreaction, not independent heat or pump credit.
definition.limits: Conditional model, not realized hits, microscopic phase measurement, nuclear contact probability, or a physical tail bound. Gaussian quartic is phase-averaged; ray centroids reflect under a named free optical scenario rather than a measured reflection law, and this does not resolve simultaneous near-wall image interference. Live acoustic background conditions the optical Palm insertions, whose additional tagged acoustic source is not replayed. Shapes outside 3 sigma, strain gradients along each ps ray, optical mode exchange and microscopic phase-dependent covariance are unretained. The accepted fixed sheet remains quiet once.
